summary: v60 testing of Social Share Cards, Buyer Invites and Google sign-in. Backend: 19/19 pytest pass (tests/test_marketing_v60_share_invites_google.py). Frontend: share bar (LinkedIn/WhatsApp/Download/Copy with toast+clipboard), OG share page meta-refresh to /notices/{ref}, 1200x630 PNG card render, /login Google button per role (hidden for escrow) + redirect URL to auth.emergentagent.com, /auth/google/:portal callback cancelled/invalid-session errors, Admin Marketing > Buyer invites send/list/mark-joined/summary all verified. One frontend crash bug found and fixed (GoogleAuthCallback rendering a 422 detail array).

minor.issue: Does not apply the config.REQUIRE_HIGH_RISK_MFA gate used by password login (escrow_agent/legal_counsel/accounting without MFA). Flag is currently false so there's no effect today, but turning it on would leave Google sign-in as a way around it. Copy the same check into google_auth.py.
_status() makes 2 extra DB lookups per invite (up to 300 rows, so up to 600 queries per list call). Batch it with $in over the emails. It also counts disabled admin_users as 'joined'.
The summary's 'clicked' count leaves out invites that are now 'joined', so the funnel shows 1 joined, 0 clicked. Consider counting clicked_at separately.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: when the exchange returned 422 (unknown portal in the URL, e.g. /auth/google/escrow#session_id=..., or a short session_id), the Pydantic detail array was rendered as a React child. This crashed the screen into the ErrorBoundary. It now shows a generic message unless detail is a string.

issues: Short (1-line) titles leave a large empty band between the title and the facts row. Consider vertically centring the block or adding the budget/description there.

action_items: Add the REQUIRE_HIGH_RISK_MFA high-risk role check to the google_auth.py staff portal path
Batch the buyer-invite status lookups (N+1) and decide whether disabled accounts count as joined
Optional: rebalance the share card layout for short titles
critical_code_review_comments: google_auth.py follows the spec: existing accounts only (404 'Register first'), disabled accounts get 403, MFA-enabled staff are refused, the admin portal requires the admin role, and the staff portal picks only from STAFF_ROLES (never 'admin'). It clears the other portal's cookie.
google_auth.py: SESSION_DATA_URL is hardcoded. It's the documented Emergent constant, so that's acceptable.
marketing_share.py: titles and descriptions are HTML-escaped (verified with <b>, quotes and apostrophes). The url in the meta refresh isn't escaped, but ref comes from the DB, so the risk is low.
Buyer invite emails were really sent through Resend (200) to @pmcmanagers.com TEST_ addresses.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ notices were created and published through the API and then deleted (mkt_alert_log cleaned too). TEST_ buyer invites, mkt_contacts and the admin_users stub were deleted. Note: the notice_seq counter advanced (PMC-NOT-2026-0054 was used).
